purpose: Fix the defects that the independent #181/#399 surface reviews confirmed on Tasks, Summary, Sources and the chat reader, plus the tooling nits left from the release PR reviews.

authorization.grantedBy: owner (netbka), delegated to the owner's main session
authorization.text: On 2026-10-11 the owner instructed in the controlling session: "do all. complete all work. merge to main. clean worktrees. tell me when all issues in PR's are resolved." and earlier delegated product decisions to this session ("Review the product and guidlines. Make own decision"). This campaign repairs the defects confirmed by the independently verified review reports R1-TASKS (Dyk #181 comment 6110240782), R2-SUMMARY (comment 6110395680), R3-SOURCES (comment 6110515789) and R4-READER (comment 6110630769) of campaign dyk-181-399-review, and the non-blocking tooling findings recorded on Dyk PR #509 (comment 6110546869). Design choices the reports left open are decided in the controller fix plan posted on Dyk #181 (comments 6110639329 and 6110721307) with the reason for each. No owner-reserved item is touched (manual task editing stays as is per the owner). Bounded repairs under Dyk AGENTS.md section 4; visible changes are represented in Storybook and independently reviewed before merge. PRs only, never merge or deploy; no production access. No limits; provider subscription limits and the no-progress guard are the stops. Providers Claude then Codex (owner: "Use codex or claude agent").

constraints: No production access, deployment, GitHub Actions, paid services, or Playwright and other browser-driven tests (Dyk owner rule). Local disposable SQL only through the repository runners (npm run test:sql / npm run journeys with a selected scope) when a task changes a route or persistence; never the production database.

Keep the affected Storybook stories in sync with every renderer change (Storybook is not post-hoc documentation). RU/EN/HE, true Hebrew RTL, 320/390 widths, 44px hit areas, no horizontal overflow, truthful states (T2).
Never read .env contents, credentials, private conversations or real user data; fixtures are synthetic.
A Storybook build or passing tests is not visual acceptance; each PR lists the story ids for independent visual review and states that the visual verdict is pending.

Do not remove worktrees, delete branches or link another checkout's node_modules. Do not add any new blocking gate, lock, required approval or check that depends on owner-provisioned keys, credentials or setup (Dyk AGENTS.md section 4).
Never weaken an existing test, guard or assertion; never add a capability outside the accepted feature map unless the task names the owner decision that adds it.

Open PR #500 (another session) rewrites short copy in about 20 files, including task-board-ui.js and screen-copy.js. Change copy in those files only where an item needs it, keep each edit minimal, and say in the PR which #500 files you touched.
Do not change any task editing behavior (date, title, action, summary, Done/Undo, person correction): the owner decided to keep it as is.
